seo_title: APTEL Orders Full Tariff for JSW Wind Power Beyond CUF
title: APTEL Sets Aside APERC's CUF-Based Payment Cap, Orders Full Tariff on JSW Wind Power's Andhra PPAs
case_name: JSW Vayu (Tungabhadra) Pvt. Ltd., JSW Vayu (Indravati) Pvt. Ltd., JSW Wind Power (Pennar) Pvt. Ltd. and JSW Wind Power Ltd. v. Andhra Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission and AP discoms
citation: Batch of 23 appeals against APERC orders capping wind tariff payment at the normative capacity utilisation factor; APTEL judgment dated 17 November 2026
card_summary: APTEL set aside APERC orders capping payment for wind power delivered beyond the normative capacity utilisation factor, ruling on 23 appeals by JSW Vayu and JSW Wind Power companies against Andhra Pradesh discoms. It held the PPAs carried no clause limiting payment to that benchmark and ordered the discoms to pay for all delivered power at the applicable tariff, with interest on amounts withheld.
card_tip: A wind PPA silent on a CUF ceiling does not let the procurer cap payment there on its own; APTEL reads the payment obligation from the PPA's own terms, not from an outside load-dispatch benchmark.
verification_notes: The 17 November 2026 order date, the four JSW appellant companies, the APERC/AP discom respondents, the batch of 23 appeals, and the direction to pay all delivered energy at the applicable PPA tariff with interest are reported consistently across SolarQuarter, Business Upturn and Saur Energy (plus Mercom India and PSU Connect, not cited to keep the source list to three), all filed within days of the order. The original APERC order's own date is given inconsistently across sources (one cites 18 October 2023, another a 26 September 2022 order) so that figure is omitted here rather than stated. The order text itself was not independently opened; the account rests on these three outlets' consistent reporting of the operative directions.
